methodology: The original research topic and the generated technical specification were decomposed into atomic units based on individual requirements, features, behaviors, and constraints. Each atomic unit is designed to be independent, self-contained, technically specific, unambiguous, and implementable as a single requirement. This ensures a granular comparison between the two sets of information.
mindtraced_atomic_units: Design a 12-hour clock with AM/PM indicator using BCD counters.
Clock receives a fast clock signal 'clk'.
A 1 Hz enable signal 'ena' derived from 'clk' increments the seconds counter.
Seconds counter rolls over to 00 and increments the minutes counter when it reaches 59.
Minutes counter rolls over to 00 and increments the hours counter when it reaches 59.
Hours counter counts from 01 to 12, rolling over to 01 after 12.
The 'pm' signal is initialized to AM (0) upon reset.
The 'pm' signal toggles when the hour counter transitions from 11 to 12.
An active-high synchronous reset signal resets the clock to 12:00 AM.
spec_atomic_units: Module top_module has inputs clk, reset, and ena.
Module top_module has outputs pm, hh, mm, and ss.
clk is a fast-running clock signal.
reset is an active-high synchronous reset signal.
reset forces the clock to its initial state of "12:00 AM".
reset has priority over the enable signal.
ena pulses once per second.
ena dictates when the seconds counter should increment.
minutes and hours counters increment based on the seconds counter reaching its maximum value.
pm is a single-bit register indicating AM (logic low) or PM (logic high).
hh is an 8-bit register representing hours in BCD format (01-12).
mm is an 8-bit register representing minutes in BCD format (00-59).
ss is an 8-bit register representing seconds in BCD format (00-59).
Seconds increment logic checks if ss is 59, then resets to 00 or increments by 1 if ena is asserted and reset is not asserted.
Minutes increment logic checks if ss is 59 and mm is 59, then resets to 00 or increments mm by 1 if ena is asserted and reset is not asserted.
Hours increment logic checks if ss and mm are 59 and hh is 12, then resets to 01 or increments hh by 1 if ena is asserted and reset is not asserted.
AM/PM Toggle Logic checks if ss and mm are 59 and hh is 11, then toggles pm if ena is asserted and reset is not asserted.
Reset Logic sets ss and mm to 00, hh to 12, and pm to 0 (AM) if reset is asserted.
The clock increments on the rising edge of clk when ena is asserted, unless reset is asserted.
pm signal toggles when the hour transitions from 11 to 12.
hh, mm, and ss are updated on the rising edge of clk based on the counter logic.
ena is assumed to be derived from clk and has a frequency of 1 Hz.
The reset signal synchronously resets the registers to their initial values (hh=12, mm=00, ss=00, pm=0).
